## Text-tone baseline (`claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`, product prompt, `is_escalated` rule)

- Rule (label ∈ ESCALATION_LABELS or any escalation dim ≥ 60): acc 86%, bal-acc 82%, precision 78%, recall 74%, AUC (max escalation dim) 0.90; self nudges 5 hit / 1 miss / 1 false.
- LOSO threshold on the max escalation dim: acc 86%, bal-acc 87%, precision 71%, recall 89%; nudges 6/0/3.
